The '''Leeching Frond''' was a type of frond native to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. It had dark green and pointy leaves that and grew in shallow waters such as lakes. The Leeching Frond was hardy enough to even grow among piles of refuse such as crashed [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. These plants were a common sight around the planets capital of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Onderonian Botanist" />
